<script>
import re

EXTENSIONS = ("xlsx", "mp4")
PLUGIN = re.compile(r"(<plugin>\s*<groupId>org\.apache\.maven\.plugins</groupId>\s*"
                    r"<artifactId>maven-resources-plugin</artifactId>)(.*?)(\n([ \t]*)</plugin>)", re.S)


def block(indent):
    inner = "".join(f"\n{indent}            <nonFilteredFileExtension>{e}</nonFilteredFileExtension>"
                    for e in EXTENSIONS)
    return (f"\n{indent}    <configuration>\n{indent}        <nonFilteredFileExtensions>{inner}"
            f"\n{indent}        </nonFilteredFileExtensions>\n{indent}    </configuration>")


def fix(p):
    path = "ndirs-back/pom.xml"
    text = p.read(path)
    if "<nonFilteredFileExtensions>" in text:
        p.log(f"{path}: nonFilteredFileExtensions already configured")
        return
    m = PLUGIN.search(text)
    if not m or "<configuration>" in m.group(2):
        p.log(f"{path}: maven-resources-plugin block not found (or already configured) - not changed")
        return
    new = text[:m.end(2)] + block(m.group(4)) + text[m.end(2):]
    p.write(path, new)
    p.log(f"{path}: maven-resources-plugin nonFilteredFileExtensions " + ", ".join(EXTENSIONS))
</script>
